lab_questions.title: Peak Concurrent User Sessions
lab_questions.description:
A devops infrastructure monitoring tool tracks active user sessions on a web platform. Each session has a start time and an end time (both inclusive integer timestamps).

Your task is to read the total number of sessions N, followed by N pairs of start and end timestamps, and calculate the maximum number of concurrent active user sessions recorded at any single timestamp.

tasks.title: Test Case 1
tasks.description:
Validate your code against test case 1.
Input:
3
1 5
2 6
4 8
Expected Output: 3

solution.python:
import sys
data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
if data:
    n = data[0]
    events = []
    idx = 1
    for _ in range(n):
        s, e = data[idx], data[idx+1]
        events.append((s, 1))
        events.append((e + 1, -1))
        idx += 2
    events.sort()
    max_c = curr = 0
    for t, delta in events:
        curr += delta
        max_c = max(max_c, curr)
    print(max_c)
